findings.finding: 27 column search inputs (16 in view-raw-punct, 11 in view-raw-connection) and 3 selects in view-raw-punct carry no oninput/onchange/onkeyup attribute at all. Typing in them cannot filter anything.
findings.fix: Wire them to the existing render function, or remove the header filter row until it is implemented.

findings.finding: #rpt-aufschluss-1/-2/-3 have no onchange attribute, which is why changing the breakdown leaves the table unchanged. The report's main analysis control is inert at the source.
findings.fix: Add an onchange that re-renders the table, mirroring what the Pünktlichkeit report should do.

findings.finding: The 'Anwenden' (apply) and 'Zurücksetzen' (reset) buttons in view-ausfallmaske have no onclick attribute. The mask's whole filter form has no working commit or reset.
findings.fix: Wire both buttons, or hide the filter form until they work.

findings.finding: Buttons with no onclick: CSV Export on view-report-fa, the treemap camera button on view-report-fa, and the Snapshot + fullscreen buttons in the Pünktlichkeit chart popup. The same-looking CSV button on V5 and V11 does respond.
findings.fix: Wire the four buttons to the existing snackbar/handlers, or remove them.

findings.finding: 37 data-i18n keys used in the markup exist in NEITHER the en nor the de dictionary, so those elements never translate and keep their hardcoded German default. They cluster in the Fahrtausfälle mask (fa_mask_*, fa_col_*, fa_opt_*) and the raw punctuality columns (punct_raw_col_*, punct_col_ist, punct_col_delta).
findings.fix: Add the 37 missing keys to both dictionaries; the full list is in the round report.
